dedupe_keys.name: fraunhofer lbf small wind turbine fault measurements

description: Fraunhofer LBF publishes monitoring observations from a 750-W wind turbine subjected to controlled fault conditions outdoors. Measurements cover vibration, rotor-speed sensing, structural temperature, wind and supporting weather information. Separate archives represent healthy operation, several imbalance levels, aerodynamic changes and bearing damage, with an Excel weather file. The Zenodo version record is public and free under CC BY 4.0. The collection covers a 2024-published experimental campaign and can validate condition-monitoring and degradation simulations whose availability assumptions feed electricity-system models such as model-pypsa. A caveat is that a small test turbine does not reproduce every mechanism or load regime of a commercial fleet. Variable weather and electrical noise influence the signals.
